title: Calibrate model policy
description: Per-project routing policy: which Claude model tier handles each phase of work, and when to escalate.

provisional.description: True when the policy was written from a greenfield interview rather than repo evidence — re-calibrate once real code exists.

calibratedAt.description: Date the policy was last generated or re-calibrated.

when.description: Trigger: a path glob (paths:src/auth/**), a signal (tests_failed_twice, user_retry), or free text the router interprets.

action.description: What to do, e.g. 'review uses opus' or 'raise code one tier for this task'.

model.description: Tier alias (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable) resolved by Claude Code to the current version of that tier, or a full model id to pin a specific version.

rationale.description: One line of evidence-based justification. Required so the policy stays auditable.

pinned.description: User override — re-calibration must not change a pinned phase.
